notes: No restaurant table by state or country appears in the FY2024 10-K, or in the FY2023, FY2022 and FY2019 10-Ks, which were also checked: Item 2 gives only the total (3,726 restaurants) and Item 1 splits them into 3,644 U.S. and 82 international company-owned restaurants, plus three international licensed restaurants (spelled out as 'three', so not recorded as a value). The Q4 2024 earnings release (8-K exhibit 99.1) also has no state breakdown; it lists the countries (U.S., Canada, U.K., France, Germany, Kuwait, UAE) without counts. So usStates is null. Employees: 127,820 in the U.S. and 2,684 internationally, a region the filing itself defines as Canada, France, Germany and the United Kingdom. The 82 international restaurants are not assigned to countries in the filing, so that region's countries list is null. Rows from different sentences of the 10-K are kept as separate rows, so the U.S. appears twice (restaurants, employees) with different metric keys.
